summary: The candidate is a partial fix. Its new retract_all eviction makes the reported active-request RadixCache prefix unmatchable and its focused suite passes, but Scheduler.pause_generation skips retract_all when there are no active requests. An independently constructed scheduler-level case left a four-token prefix from a completed request fully matchable across retract pause, violating the original old-weight KV invalidation contract.

tests.what_was_measured: Candidate regression against the exact recorded base: 3 failed and 2 passed; the real RadixCache prefix remained matchable on base.
Candidate regression and related scheduler/lock tests: 37 passed and 2 subtests passed. Imports resolved to /job/repo/python/sglang and the candidate schedule_batch.py.
Independent scheduler-level idle-pause boundary: a completed-request prefix matched 4 of 4 tokens after retract pause because retract_all was not invoked for an empty active request set.
One visible AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 under Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; a device tensor sum returned 6.0. This only inventories GPU execution and does not validate the cache contract.

gpu_execution.evidence: A simple tensor operation ran on the assigned single AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950. The issue-specific deterministic cache tests were CPU-side; no model inference was claimed.

remaining_counterexamples: With a reusable radix prefix from a completed request and no currently active request, pause_generation(mode='retract') skips retract_all; the prefix remains matchable after pause (4/4 tokens in the independent case).
Disaggregated-prefill live mid-chunk requests are deliberately retained by existing pause_generation logic, so stale-weight KV remains possible in that documented path.

HiRadixCache write-back eviction can demote/stage device entries to host rather than perform the reset needed for a complete provenance-invalidating boundary; the candidate calls generic evict and does not reset hierarchical backing state.
remaining_limitations: The prepared runtime did not include the reported Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 weights, so no full-model weight swap, logprob comparison, or generated-text comparison was run.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned; no multi-GPU or multi-node behavior was tested.
The HiRadix/hierarchical-cache concern is supported by inspected eviction/reset source semantics but was not instantiated end-to-end because no hierarchical backing-store fixture was prepared.
No native source changed in the candidate, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
